name: Siemens S7-1500 / PLCSIM Advanced interoperability profile I/O map (OPC UA)
description: Versioned S37 mapping document for the S47 Siemens / PLCSIM interoperability profile. It maps the shared Fabrik3D CNC reference-cell signals (equipment 'showcase.cell') to Siemens S7-1500 data-block tags exposed by the CPU's OPC UA server (TIA Portal namespace index 3, quoted DB syntax). It is the single source of truth the automated CI substitute projects into the real OPC UA connector; the CI fixture serves the same symbolic identifiers in its own namespace so only the namespace index differs, never the identifier, direction, type or scaling. No Siemens project file, binary, license or secret is committed.

entries.name: Cell start command → DB tag Start
entries.description: PLC → Fabrik3D (read). Momentary start request; a rising edge is acted on while the cell is ready and a pallet is present.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Bool. Held in a command data block (for example 'Fabrik3D_Cell_DB'.Start); write it from the PLC program, not from a table.

entries.name: Cell stop command → DB tag Stop
entries.description: PLC → Fabrik3D (read). When set while the robot or CNC cycle is active the cell latches a fault and quiesces.

entries.name: Cell reset command → DB tag Reset
entries.description: PLC → Fabrik3D (read). Clears a latched fault or completion and returns the cell to the ready sequence.

entries.name: Pallet detection photo-eye → DB tag PalletPresent
entries.description: PLC → Fabrik3D (read). Simulated pallet-present sensor on the infeed conveyor; start is refused until it is true.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Bool. On a real cell this is an I/O input mapped into the DB.

entries.name: Robot cycle target → DB tag CycleTarget
entries.description: PLC → Fabrik3D (read). Normalized robot transfer-axis setpoint (0-100 engineering units) for the pick-and-place cycle.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Int (or DInt); the value is transmitted as an OPC UA integer. 0..100, no scaling.

entries.name: Cell ready status → DB tag Ready
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Permissives satisfied: no stop, no latched fault.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Bool. Written by Fabrik3D; read it back in the PLC program.

entries.name: Cell running status → DB tag Running
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). True during the robot and CNC phases, false in ready, complete and fault.

entries.name: Robot cycle complete status → DB tag RobotCycleComplete
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Latched when the robot has transferred the pallet to the CNC; cleared by reset.

entries.name: CNC cycle complete status → DB tag CncCycleComplete
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Latched when the virtual CNC cycle has finished; cleared by reset.

entries.name: Full cycle complete status → DB tag CycleComplete
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Latched when the whole pallet cycle is complete; cleared by reset.

entries.name: Cell fault status → DB tag Fault
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Latched on stop during a cycle; cleared by reset only.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Bool. This is a diagnostic status, not a safety-rated signal.

entries.name: Virtual actuator position → DB tag ActuatorPosition
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Normalized transfer-axis position (0-100) the virtual actuator has reached.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Int (or DInt). 0..100, no scaling.

entries.name: Virtual sensor position feedback → DB tag SensorPosition
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Virtual position sensor measurement returned to the controller, closing the loop.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Int (or DInt). 0..100, no scaling.

entries.name: Completed part count → DB tag PartsCompleted
entries.description: Fabrik3D → PLC (write). Number of finished pallets produced since power-up; cleared only by a controller restart.
entries.notes: Siemens type: Int (or DInt). Counter, no scaling.
